summary: Example task gets WeOS 4 version info with the platform-independent cli_command.
questions: How do I run show version on a WeOS 4 device?

answer_card.title: Get WeOS 4 version
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Get version information (WeOS 4)
  ansible.netcommon.cli_command:
    commands: "show version"
  register: show_ver
  when: ansible_network_os == 'community.network.weos4'
```
